# dsh-im-union

A union IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness — a clean-room reimplementation merging the capability sets of xmanrui/dsh-im and MichengAI/dsh-im-connect, with no source copied from either.

## Status

Under development (M0 cross-version skeleton). See `tasks.md` for phasing.

## Install (npm package available after M1)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-im-union@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
node scripts/sync-hosts.mjs --write
```
